column1: # Candidate sweep manifest. Columns separated by exactly ONE tab.
# Order: label <tab> hf_repo <tab> filename <tab> params
# WHY THESE: S_perf = min(TPS/15, 1.0)*100, so throughput above ~15 tok/s scores
# nothing extra. The goal is the LARGEST, most accurate model that still clears
# 15 tok/s on the audit VM -- not the fastest model available.
# Run ./verify_candidates.sh before ./sweep.sh: it HEAD-requests every URL and
# tells you which are real in ~10 seconds, instead of failing mid-download.
# ---- VERIFIED against the HuggingFace API, 18 Aug 2026 -----------------------
# Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-GGUF (the official repo) publishes ONLY Q8_0 -- no Q4_K_M.
# The unsloth mirror below carries the full quant range. "UD" = Unsloth Dynamic
# quantization: same file size as Q4_K_M, measurably better quality.
qwen3-1.7b-q4km
qwen3-1.7b-udq4xl
qwen25-1.5b-q4km
llama32-1b-q4km

# Both ~1.9 GB. If either clears 15 tok/s on the audit VM it likely wins outright,
# because the extra parameters buy accuracy that the capped throughput term
# no longer charges us for.
qwen3-4b-q3km
